evidence.paraphrase: A sidecar hit concurrency limits; its autoscaling policy watched host-service limits. Saturated load balancers degraded authentication.

evidence.location: Resolved report, paragraphs beginning Some of the failing traffic; The retry storm; Residual Copilot; Complicating factors paragraph before follow-up actions
evidence.paraphrase: Traffic rerouting served requests successfully. Software gateway retries and a latent VS Code retry bug amplified load; reducing retries and controlling incoming traffic stabilised recovery. GitHub also reports scraping attacks impeded recovery; their AI origin is not disclosed.

evidence.location: Resolved report, first two paragraphs and Residual Copilot paragraph
evidence.paraphrase: Copilot Token Service was affected. The account identifies client retry logic, without attributing initiation or retry decisions to an AI agent.
Planned controls cover autoscaling, sidecar limits, client/gateway backoff, capacity monitoring and failover safeguards; staffing or expertise loss is not disclosed.
Reported window: 17 August 2026, 13:28-21:15 UTC; most services recovered 16:36, Actions approximately 18:03, Copilot Token Service 21:02.
